name: Shingo (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shingo village emblem in white: a ring open at the top with a stylised letter V and hooked stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Shingo, a village in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 March 1973.

features.role: Shingo village emblem — a ring open at the top with a stylised letter V and hooked stroke
